messages:
olivia: PTAL — I pushed a followup to address the deadlock we saw in the serializer under high concurrency. Rebased onto main and added a focused unit test (serializer_concurrency_test) that reproduces the issue locally.
raj: thanks! quick skim — looks good. did you preserve the old API flags? we rely on the `--disable-prefetch` flag in some runtime configs.
olivia: yes, left the flag in and added a comment explaining why prefetch is unsafe for concurrent flush. Also updated CHANGELOG and docs/serializer.md.
micah: can you drop the noisy test logs? CI logs are >20MB. also, do we need a follow-up to audit telemetry? pinging @merge-ops for canary slot.
olivia: removed debug logs, replaced with `log.debug()` guarded. telemetry is a separate follow-up — created issue #1284.
ci-bot: build started for olivia/serializer-fix (sha: a1b2c3) — running unit & integration.
ci-bot: unit tests passed
ci-bot: integration linux/gcc failed (timeout) — retrying
ci-bot: integration linux/gcc passed on retry
raj: can you squash the fixup commits? prefer keeping the original incremental commits for history — what's your preference?
olivia: prefer not to squash — the intermediate commits map to distinct experiments we may want to trace. happy to rebase/fold the tiny fixups if needed. thoughts?
micah: fine to keep history, but please ensure the PR description notes the bisectable commits.
olivia: updated PR description with commit map and added manual repro steps.
merge-ops: FYI we have a canary slot tomorrow 10:00 PT. If this PR gets 2 approvals and CI green by 08:00 PT we'll schedule it.
raj: LGTM after small nits — left one inline about a comment. :thumbsup:
olivia: addressed the nit, pushed. ptal when you have 5.
raj: looked — lgtm. approving now.
micah: approved. thanks for moving fast.
ci-bot: all checks passed. ready for merge.
olivia: thanks! @merge-ops please merge when convenient before the 08:00 PT deadline if slots are available.
merge-ops: noted — will merge in the morning if no last-minute regressions pop up. :white_check_mark:
